hypothesis: Persistent crypto price discovery can make a volatility-buffered Donchian close breakout profitable over 12–48 hours after Ostium-like costs, if the rule is structural across BTC, ETH and SOL and robust to nearby parameters.
derivation_disclosure: V21 is a new trend mechanism, not a local variation of v20 reclaim, v18 compression breakout, v17 weekly relative momentum or v13 session breakout. It uses a continuous H4 Donchian state, an ATR entry buffer and optional ATR trailing exit, with the complete grid frozen before performance access.

data_contract.input: checksummed Binance spot M1 aggregated to strict UTC H4; price-only
data_contract.signal_time: completed H4 close only; next complete H4 open entry
data_contract.indicator_policy: Donchian and EMA use completed bars strictly before the signal close; ATR14 includes the completed signal bar only for sizing/buffer
data_contract.proxy_limitation: No promotion before native Ostium coverage and parity

execution_contract.entry: close above/below prior Donchian channel plus/minus entry_buffer_atr times signal ATR; optional EMA regime must agree with side
execution_contract.exit: initial ATR stop, optional causal chandelier ATR trail based on completed prior bars, or frozen 3/6/12 H4 maximum hold
execution_contract.universal_rule: identical parameters on BTCUSD, ETHUSD and SOLUSD
execution_contract.portfolio_scheduler: sort by entry time and asset; accept at most two concurrent 1%-risk positions; later simultaneous signals skipped
execution_contract.boundary_policy: skip any trade whose full maximum hold cannot finish inside its evaluated period

stability.representative: graph medoid of largest stable component without performance metrics

small_account.leverage_rule: Highest venue leverage whose liquidation distance is at least 1.25 times the initial stop distance.

family_stop_rule.stop_after_internal_walk_forward_if: zero representatives pass every aggregate, per-asset, per-fold and drop-one gate
family_stop_rule.global_holdout_policy: Survivors enter a final-cohort waitlist; no family-level holdout release.
family_stop_rule.sqcli_policy: SQ reproduction on consumed periods only after internal survival; never a promotion by itself.
